refresh.name: Refresh model detection
refresh.description: Detect a supported sibling model again and reload the Ecovacs integration.

rediscover.name: Rediscover
rediscover.description: Ignore the cache and query the Ecovacs cloud again.

no_sibling_found.title: Unsupported Ecovacs model: {device_class}
no_sibling_found.description: The device class `{device_class}` ({product}) is not supported by deebot_client and no similar supported model was found. Set `hardware_override` in the configuration of this integration to pick a model manually, or report your model upstream at https://github.com/DeebotUniverse/client.py.
